observations: The page number «71» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 70 (JP2 0102, L14), «Hieraus muss man, wenn». L23-L24: the heading of chapter 24, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.

L05: «ut in sequenti tabula subnotatur», the end of the fourth paragraph of chapter 23 of the Latin text (p. 17, JP2 0049, L27), in italics within German quotation marks. L10-L22: the figure of p. 70 (JP2 0102), which Suter adds from Ms. N; his reading of it agrees with the check recorded there.

L13-L20. Checked: 30 + 21;57,41 = 51;57,41 and 51;57,41 + 8;2,19 = 60; 60 sin 60° = 51;57,41.5; the sines of 210°, 240°, 270°, 300° and 330° are equal to these in magnitude, with the negative sign that p. 69 (JP2 0101, L26) sets aside.

L25-L36. Checked: at the equinoxes the sun stands on the equator, whose meridian altitude is 90° less the latitude; for a northern declination δ the meridian altitude is 90° − φ + δ, for a southern one 90° − φ − δ, so that φ = 90° − (H ∓ δ); a circumpolar star culminates at φ + p and φ − p, p its distance from the pole, so that the latitude is the mean of its greatest and least altitudes, h′ + (h″ − h′)/2 = (h′ + h″)/2. L27 and L30: the minus signs printed as long dashes, with a space on either side, «∓» the minus-plus sign; L35: the formula at the left margin, within large round brackets, its two fractions built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}, a full stop after it; H, φ, δ, h′, h″ in italics.

L19: the full stop after the last «M» is printed below the base line (its top 4 px under the line, where the other points stand on it); transcribed as a full stop. L09: «Abū’l-Ḥasan ʿAlī» spaced, with the dot under the Ḥ, the ʿayn raised; «„Tafel des Kh.“» not spaced. L01: «Muh. b. Mūsā al-Kh.» spaced, «Muh.» without a dot under the h.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Muh. b. Mūsā al-Kh.», «Björnbo», «Kh.» (L08), «Abū’l-Ḥasan ʿAlī», «Athelhards», «Batt.», «Zeuthen», «Braunmühl», «Nallino»; italics: «ut in sequenti tabula subnotatur», «Signa», «djaib mustawī», «sinus planus», the letters of the formulas, «Festskrift til», «Vorlesungen über Geschichte der Trigonometrie».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (9-15 px measured; «sin I», L16, the colon before it 12 px).
